thread:
Marta R.: quick check — we shipped the client change that prefers explicit base_url over env var, but a couple customers behind proxies saw auth dropped on streaming. any quick ideas?
Kevin L.: saw that in logs earlier, looks like proxy strips Authorization header for upgrade/stream requests if Host != original host.
Sam (eng-bot): repro steps I used: `curl -v -H 'Authorization: Bearer x' -N 'https://proxy.internal/stream?target=https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate'` shows `Authorization` removed in 101 upgrade.
Olivia: ugh. sounds like classic proxy host rewrite + header blacklist. are customers using CONNECT tunnel or plain http-proxy?
Marta R.: one reported CONNECT for us-east, another had corporate inline proxy (no CONNECT).
Kevin L.: for CONNECT we should be fine (tunnel preserves headers). for inline proxies we need the client to set Host header to upstream host and/or use `Proxy-Authorization` vs `Authorization`.
Olivia: quick question — if client uses custom base_url to hit private endpoint (eg: `https://private-redwood.internal/v1`), how do we recommend configuring proxy + auth?
Marta R.: recommended flow in doc: 1) set REDWOOD_BASE_URL to private host, 2) ensure Proxy passes `Authorization` through or use mTLS. but that's vague.
Kevin L.: propose checklist to avoid surprises:
- Ensure client uses `Host` header that matches upstream (explicit if language runtime overrides)
- If corporate proxy removes `Authorization` on websocket/upgrade, prefer CONNECT/tunnel or mTLS at proxy layer
- For streaming, prefer `Connection: keep-alive` + `Upgrade: websocket` alternative if supported by runtime
- Fallback: allow `X-Forwarded-Authorization` header (customer-only, opt-in)
Sam (eng-bot): +1 to checklist. Also note Node `http(s).request` sometimes sets `Host` from URL; user libs that set `host`/`hostname` differently can cause mismatch.
Olivia: can we add client-side behavior: when base_url is custom/private -> prefer explicit `host` header set to upstream domain and include `--proxy-bypass` env suggestion?
Marta R.: I drafted a small doc snippet, want to put in SDK readme and devex article. snippet:```
# example (node)
const client = new RedwoodClient({ baseURL: process.env.REDWOOD_BASE_URL });
// ensure proxy headers aren't mutating host
const res = await client.request({
  method: 'POST',
  url: '/v1/stream',
  headers: { Host: new URL(process.env.REDWOOD_BASE_URL).host }
});
```
Kevin L.: include note to avoid double-encoding query when proxy uses path-based forwarding (some proxies append).
InfraBot: deploy log: rolled out sdk@1.12.1 -> analytics: small uptick in proxy-related errors (stream-reset) in EU region.
Marta R.: ok action items: (1) add checklist to devex doc (2) add node/python snippet for Host header override (3) add troubleshooting quick commands (curl/curl --http1.1/CONNECT example) (4) ping infra for proxy config guidance
Kevin L.: I'll open a tiny PR with docs + test that simulates inline proxy stripping Authorization so CI fails if we regress.
Olivia: I'll collect repro headers from the two customers and add anonymized examples.
Sam (eng-bot): FYI reproducer curl for inline proxy case:```
# inline-proxy repro
curl -v -H "Authorization: Bearer AAA" -H "Host: api.redwood.ai"
  -x http://inline.proxy:3128
  "https://api.redwood.ai/v1/stream?x=1"
# watch the proxy logs for missing Authorization on upgrade
```
Marta R.: putting a short note in customer-facing KB: if you see `401` only on streaming, try `export NO_PROXY=api.redwood.ai` or contact infra to allow `Authorization` through.
Kevin L.: also add a short snippet for `CONNECT` style (curl --proxy-insecure --proxytunnel).
Olivia: small ask — can we make the SDK emit a debug line when using custom base_url + proxy env var set? something like `REDWOOD_DEBUG=client:proxy` to show resolved host/header pair.
Marta R.: agreed — please keep debug off by default. Kevin, want to include in PR?
Kevin L.: yep. will draft tonight, link when ready.
InfraBot: note: security wants us to avoid encouraging `X-Forwarded-Authorization` unless customer signs waiver.
Marta R.: ok we will make that opt-in and document the risks.
Olivia: thanks all — I'll follow up with the customer notes and link to PR when ready. :thumbsup:
Kevin L.: pinging for review once PR is up @Marta R.
Marta R.: thanks — closing this thread when PR merged.
